toegepas.blok: Vier dinge vir 'n plant wat groei
toegepas.voor: Hierdie vier dinge het enige groen plant nodig wat al bo die grond groei.
toegepas.na: Enige groen plant wat al bo die grond groei, het hierdie vier dinge nodig.
toegepas.rede_vinder: With the object fronted and the relative clause split from its noun, a Grade 4 reader can mistake which is the subject; subject-first order is clearer.
toegepas.fout: Fronted object with the relative clause split from 'plant' lets the sentence read as 'these four things need any green plant'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Subject-first order removes the ambiguity for a Grade 4 reader without changing who needs what.

toegepas.voor: bleek en die stam lank en swak
toegepas.na: bleek, en die stam word lank en swak
toegepas.rede_vinder: Three 'en's in a row blur where the second clause starts; repeating the verb makes it a full clause, which then takes the AWS comma.
toegepas.fout: Three 'en's in a row with a gapped verb blur where the second clause begins.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Repeating 'word' makes the second clause explicit and takes the AWS comma; meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Water is een van hierdie vier dinge
toegepas.na: Water is een van die vier dinge
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'hierdie' points back to a list that is not in this block; 'die vier dinge' refers to it naturally.
toegepas.fout: 'hierdie' points to a list given in another block.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'die vier dinge' refers back naturally and lets the block stand on its own with the same meaning.

toegepas.voor: Die wortels suig water uit die grond na die res van die plant.
toegepas.na: Die wortels suig water uit die grond op, en die water gaan na die res van die plant.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'suig ... na die res van die plant' is unidiomatic, since sucking draws towards the one sucking; splitting it keeps both steps of the meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'suig ... na die res van die plant' is unidiomatic: sucking draws towards the one sucking.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Splitting into 'suig ... op' and 'gaan na' fixes the verb and keeps both steps without adding a fact.

toegepas.blok: Lug by die blare en die wortels
toegepas.voor: Die blare kry lug bo die grond en die wortels
toegepas.na: Die blare kry lug bo die grond, en die wortels
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: a comma goes before 'en' that joins two sentences, each with its own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both halves are full clauses ('Die blare kry', 'die wortels kry'), so the AWS 2017 comma is required.

toegepas.blok: Lug by die blare en die wortels
toegepas.voor: Grond wat heeltyd papnat bly laat
toegepas.na: Grond wat heeltyd papnat bly, laat
toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma between the relative clause's verb and the main verb ('bly, laat') stops the two verbs running together, as in 'In grond wat papnat bly, kom' later in the lesson.
toegepas.fout: The relative clause's verb 'bly' runs straight into the main verb 'laat'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma separates the two verbs as the lesson already does in 'In grond wat papnat bly, kom'.

toegepas.voor: met 'n paar blare aan heet 'n steggie
toegepas.na: met 'n paar blare daaraan word 'n steggie genoem
toegepas.rede_vinder: A bare 'aan' at the end of the phrase is colloquial and 'heet' is stiff for Grade 4; 'daaraan' and 'word ... genoem' are the natural forms.
toegepas.fout: 'blare aan heet' makes the reader stumble, and 'heet' is stiff for Grade 4.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'daaraan' and 'word ... genoem' are the plain, natural forms and name the same thing.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'binne-in' is the natural form for 'inside' at the end of a clause, and the lesson uses it elsewhere.
toegepas.fout: A bare 'binne' at the end of the clause reads clipped.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'binne-in' is the natural clause-final form and matches the lesson's own usage, with the same meaning.

toegepas.voor: moet sy eerste worteltjie en blare nog uitstoot
toegepas.na: moet nog sy eerste worteltjie en blare uitstoot
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'nog' belongs right after the modal verb; putting it after the object is unnatural.
toegepas.fout: 'nog' trailing after the object is unnatural.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'moet nog ... uitstoot' is the natural position and says exactly the same.

toegepas.voor: Ontkieming is die woord vir 'n saad wat oopbars en begin groei.
toegepas.na: Ontkieming is wanneer 'n saad oopbars en begin groei.
toegepas.rede_vinder: As written, the word names the seed rather than the process; the change matches the glossary's 'Wanneer 'n saad oopbars'.
toegepas.fout: As written, 'die woord vir 'n saad wat oopbars' names the seed rather than the process.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal names the process and lines the study text up with the glossary wording without changing the meaning.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'ondertoe' is the standard one-word form and matches 'boontoe' in the next sentence.
toegepas.fout: 'na onder toe' is a loose, doubled form.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'ondertoe' is the standard one-word form and matches 'boontoe' in the next sentence.

toegepas.blok: Wat 'n saad nodig het om te ontkiem
toegepas.rede_vinder: The same block refers to the seed as 'dit' ('voordat dit kan ontkiem'); keep the pronoun consistent.
toegepas.fout: The pronoun for the seed switches from 'dit' to 'hy' within one block.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'dit' keeps the reference consistent with 'voordat dit kan ontkiem' in the same block; meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: 'n Saad en 'n plant wat groei het nie
toegepas.na: 'n Saad en 'n plant wat groei, het nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: Without the comma, 'groei het' runs the relative clause's verb into the main verb and the sentence is hard to parse.
toegepas.fout: 'groei het' runs the relative clause's verb into the main verb, so the sentence is hard to parse.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma marks the end of the relative clause and leaves every word intact.

toegepas.voor: Water, lug en warmte het die saad en die plant wat groei albei nodig.
toegepas.na: Die saad en die plant wat groei, het albei water, lug en warmte nodig.
toegepas.rede_vinder: With the object fronted, it is unclear who needs what; subject first is clearer and keeps every word of the meaning.
toegepas.fout: Fronted object makes it momentarily unclear who needs what.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Subject-first order is clearer, keeps every word of the meaning, and leaves the protected next sentence untouched.

toegepas.voor: Hoe sal jy kan sien watter een
toegepas.na: Hoe kan jy sien watter een
toegepas.rede_vinder: The double modal 'sal ... kan' is heavy for Grade 4; 'Hoe kan jy sien' says the same thing.
toegepas.fout: 'Hoe sal jy kan sien' is a heavy double modal for a Grade 4 reader.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Hoe kan jy sien' is plainer and asks the same question.

laat_vaar.voor: maak baie maklik wortels op hierdie manier
laat_vaar.na: maak op hierdie manier baie maklik wortels
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: In Afrikaans the adverbial of manner sits more naturally before the object than trailing at the end.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original word order reads naturally; moving the adverbial is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'voor hom gegroei' (grew before it, the seed) reads awkwardly and 'hom' for the seed clashes with 'dit' elsewhere; 'al voorheen' keeps the meaning.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'al voorheen' loses the relation 'before it (the seed)' and is vaguer, while the original is correct Afrikaans.

laat_vaar.blok: Wat om te meet en aan te teken
laat_vaar.voor: Tel hoeveel blare die plantjie elke week het.
laat_vaar.na: Tel elke week hoeveel blare die plantjie het.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'elke week' belongs with the instruction 'tel' (count weekly), not inside the counted clause.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original is natural Afrikaans and already means counting the leaves each week; the reorder is lateral.

na_skrywer.voor: Eers suig die saad water in en dan swel dit dikker op.
na_skrywer.na: Eers suig die saad water in, en dan swel dit op.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: AWS comma between two full clauses joined by 'en'; 'swel op' already means 'gets thicker', so 'dikker' is redundant and wooden.
na_skrywer.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses joined by 'en dan'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The comma is right, but dropping 'dikker' removes the plain gloss that explains 'swel' to a Grade 4 reader, so the writer should add the comma and decide on 'dikker'.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: So 'n plant verlep heeltemal en gaan later dood.
vlae.rede: The condition (the soil stays dry even longer) is only implied, so the sentence can read as saying every drooping plant dies; restoring it means choosing content, so it goes to the writer.

vlae.teks: Jy plant twee sade. Die een pot staan in die warm son en die ander een in 'n koue kamer.
vlae.rede: 'Die een pot' has no antecedent, because pots were never mentioned; fixing it means adding that each seed is in its own pot, which is a content choice.

vlae.teks: Kyk elke week mooi wat met die twee plantjies gebeur.
vlae.rede: The block plants 'n paar boontjies' plus one cutting, so 'die twee plantjies' does not match what was planted; probably the two pots are meant, but correcting it means guessing the intent.
